subject: getParameterOrder" not available for .Call() for package

messages.author: 3126d00d0b94540e
messages.subject: getParameterOrder" not available for .Call() for package
parts:
The getParameterOrder error occurs when I attempt to run a TMB example (eg source('sam.R'))

linux mint 19.3

$ uname -a
Linux kihikihi 5.3.0-46-generic #38~18.04.1-Ubuntu SMP Tue Mar 31 04:17:56 UTC 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

$ cpp --version
cpp (GCC) 10.0.1 20200212 (experimental)

R version 3.6.2 (2019-12-12) -- "Dark and Stormy Night"


I "upgraded" to a new OS, new compiler and new R version, and just can't seem to get TMB working.

Getting desperate and frustrated. Any help gratefully received.

Thanks,
John

messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Re: getParameterOrder" not available for .Call() for package
parts:
I don't think the R-installation is the problem. To debug a bit more:

Does 'sam' appear in this list?:

getLoadedDLLs()

Do you see 'getParameterOrder' in this list?:

getDLLRegisteredRoutines("sam")

Can you run built in models?:

runExample("simple")
